message: Preparing for the unexpected can feel a bit daunting, but we like to think of it as a cozy project to tackle together! 🛠️ Building an emergency kit is a great way to ensure we have what we need, no matter what life throws our way. It’s not just about supplies; it’s about creating a sense of security and peace of mind for our families. Plus, it’s a wonderful opportunity to gather the family and turn this task into a fun little event—complete with a checklist and maybe even some snacks! What’s your favorite tip or trick for prepping an emergency kit?
